$name: Labs Design System V2 — foundations tokens
$notes: The THIRD standalone Wellx system (alongside the portal --wx-* set and Labs v1 --wl-*; neither is modified by this system). Identity: rose #C42663 accent (original Labs rose, restored), Figtree + IBM Plex Mono (numbers only), DARK-FIRST with elevated dark surfaces, 2px Lucide icons, optional resting shadows in light. Source of truth: Figma file Rr0XYMsa9OYmLmjxMCbiMz ('Wellx Labs Design System') — every value below was read from its live variables and styles on 2026-11-11. CSS layer: tokens/labs-v2.css (--wl2-* prefix, :root = dark) + tokens/labs-v2-tailwind-preset.cjs. Component recipes: tokens/labs-v2-components.json via get_labs_v2_component_spec.

meta.themeAttribute: data-theme="light" opts into the light twin; :root carries dark

primitives.$notes: Private layer — components and agents consume semantics only. gray/750–875 form the elevated-dark surface ladder.

statusTags.$notes: Borderless tint pills: -surface + -foreground pairs, icon always included, every pair >=4.5:1. Identical in both modes (tags sit on cards).

rules: Accent #C42663 (rose-600): white label = 5.52:1 (hover 7.11, active 9.04) — AA everywhere; accent keeps its hue in dark (3.56:1 vs canvas, >=3:1 non-text).
Rose as TEXT on dark canvases must be rose-400+ (#E0528B, 5.39:1); darker rose steps are forbidden for dark text.
Focus ring: rose-400 #E0528B in BOTH modes (3.65:1 light / 5.39:1 dark, >=3:1 non-text).
Signal magenta #F0366B is AI and identity ONLY — never a button, never body text on white (3.86:1).

Status color is never the only signal — every status pairs with an icon or label. This rule is load-bearing: the rose accent reads close to danger red under tritanopia (known, accepted trade-off for brand continuity).
Components and agents consume semantic tokens only; primitives are private to the theme.

typography.familyNotes: Figtree — display, headings, UI copy. Weights 400/600/700/800 only (no 300, 500, 900), never italic, never used to typeset 'wellx'. IBM Plex Mono (400/500) for NUMBERS ONLY: money, IDs, ratios, confidence values, timestamps, chart axes — never running copy, headings, or non-numeric labels; alignment is inherent to mono (tnum retired). Arabic renders via Noto Sans Arabic — stack: Figtree, 'Noto Sans Arabic', sans-serif (per-glyph fallback; Figtree has zero Arabic coverage).

text-xs.usage: captions, muted metadata — the floor, muted only

text-sm.usage: DEFAULT UI — tables, nav, inputs, buttons, forms

display-sm.usage: large KPI numerals — the numbers-only mono style; deliberately tighter leading

tracking.notes: px letter-spacings in the scale are these percentages applied per size.

rules: Line heights are percentages, constrained to 100–120% for Latin (display-sm 110% is the deliberate tight step).
12px (text-xs) is the size floor, reserved for muted metadata; 11px only as micro labels. No uppercase baked into any scale step.
All numerals render in IBM Plex Mono; letter-spacing is always 0 in mono and in Arabic (tracking breaks Arabic letter joining — display tracking is Latin-only).

rtl.lineHeightShift: +20 percentage points on every scale step (text 120→140%, text-lg/xl 115→135%, display-sm 110→130%)
rtl.letterSpacing: always 0 — tracking breaks Arabic letter joining
rtl.notes: Applied via [dir=rtl] token twins. Mirroring rules, Arabic digits policy and Arabic type QA are a separate workstream.

spacing.grid: 4px, absolute — off-grid values do not exist in the system

pairs.$notes: HIG-informed pair-wise gaps; related elements sit >=2x closer than unrelated.

radius.usage: sm: checkboxes/swatches · md: buttons/inputs/menu items · lg: cards/KPI tiles/popovers · xl: dialogs/sheets · full: pills/tags/avatars · hairline: the 1px border weight

elevation.model: Resting surfaces separate with hairline borders; LIGHT mode may add the optional shadow-resting; DARK mode expresses elevation through surface color (the gray/750–875 elevated ladder, cards #18181B on canvas #0B0B0C) and never uses resting shadows. Floating layers always pair shadow with the hairline border.

focus.input: border becomes ring color + 3px spread halo at 20%
rules: The ring is never removed, only restyled — outline:none without a replacement fails validation.
Dialogs trap focus and return it on close.
Focus order follows DOM order.

patterns.dialog: fade + scale 0.96→1, 200ms; scrim fades with it

rules: Motion is feedback for a state change — never decoration in product UI.
Animate transform and opacity only (collapse excepted).
Exits are faster than enters.
prefers-reduced-motion: non-essential motion off, state changes instant.
Nothing loops except progress indicators.
300ms is a hard ceiling for product UI.

icons.stroke: 2px ABSOLUTE at every size (Lucide default weight, held absolute — at 16px that is stroke-width 3 in viewBox units)

sizes.16: default — inline, tags, tables, inputs, sidebar

icons.color: always currentColor — icons inherit the adjacent text token; status icons get -foreground
icons.custom: drawn on the 24-grid, 2px stroke, rounded caps/joins, optically weight-checked against three Lucide neighbors

rules: Content is ALWAYS capped at 1440px and centered on wider screens — the app content column (after the sidebar) and marketing pages alike; fluid below the cap; gutters apply inside it.
Tables run full-bleed to the gutter, never to the viewport.
